The same surface piece inside a common word (Korea, pike, sleeper, bath, smoke, island), a single-token noun (Paris, dinner, garden, fully, slowly), or the same surname without its given-name context (The Correa family, 0.48 versus 1.84 with Carlos) stays weak or silent; moderate secondary bumps (0.5-0.9) on month, season and time nouns (August, noon, summer) and on single-token first names (Mike, Carlos) are acknowledged offshoots below the strong name-completion band.
